title: Indian Men's Team Secures Asian Games Bronze After Semifinal Loss to China
indian_angle: The Indian men's badminton team earned a bronze medal at the Asian Games, marking their second consecutive team medal.
summary: India's men's badminton team clinched a bronze medal at the Asian Games 2026 after a 1-3 defeat to China in the semifinals, following their silver in Hangzhou 2023.

title: Indian Men's Team Assured of Asian Games Medal After Victory Over Japan
indian_angle: The Indian men's team secured at least a bronze medal at the Asian Games by defeating Japan, continuing their strong performance in team events.
summary: The Indian men’s badminton team guaranteed themselves a medal at the Asian Games 2026 by beating Japan, adding to their previous silver in 2023 and three bronze medals.

title: Sindhu-Led Indian Women's Team Exits Asian Games in Quarterfinals
indian_angle: The Indian women's badminton team, led by PV Sindhu, concluded their Asian Games campaign after a 1-3 loss to Japan in the quarterfinals.
summary: Despite Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand winning their doubles match, the Indian women's team, led by PV Sindhu, was eliminated from the Asian Games 2026 after a 1-3 quarterfinal loss to Japan.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: Badminton Association of India organized an advanced coaching course in Guwahati and Raipur, contributing to the development of Indian badminton coaches.
summary: The Badminton Association of India conducted a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 was held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team preparing for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 was conducted at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India introduced a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
